newsitem.title: USA: US unions willing to talk with Wheeling in dispute.
newsitem.headline: US unions willing to talk with Wheeling in dispute.

text.p: The United Steelworkers of America said Wednesday it remains willing to negotiate with Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel Corp at any time and at any place to reach a resolution of the dispute.

The company said eight local union presidents from the Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel plants, meeting today, reaffirmed their commitment to ending the now six month long labor dispute and achieving a labor agreement that provides their members with a guaranteed pension with shutdown benefits.
Wheeling-Pittsburgh could not be immediately reached for comment.
The labor dispute involves nearly 4,500 Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel workers at plants in Ohio, West Virginia and Pennsylvania.
